purpose: Teach: 従兄弟/見分け/嫌っ/よくなる/こらえ/探さ/さして/ペンキ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、従兄弟、絶対、お店に来てくれたの
lines.en: Sho — I was so happy when you came to the shop. Really, truly.
lines.style: Warm, present voice. Slight lift on the opening. Genuine delight, not performed. Soft focus, like remembering something that still makes her smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、犬の種類の、絶対、見分け、絶対、できるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I can really tell the difference between dog breeds now. I'm serious.
lines.style: Small chest puff in the voice. Earnest pride without boasting. Direct eye contact in the tone. A kid stating something he knows is true, inviting her to notice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、嫌っ、絶対、てた、絶対、お野菜、絶対、最近食べてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad used to really hate vegetables, you know. But he's been eating them lately.
lines.style: Quiet observation, like sharing a small secret. Gentle tone — noticing something kind. Slight wondering lift at the end, as if he's still figuring it out.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの絵、本気で、絶対、よくなる、絶対、かな?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis — do you think my drawings will really get better? I mean, will they?
lines.style: Tentative opening. Small vulnerable lift at the first question. The second asking is quieter, more internal. Kid-honest — wanting reassurance but not quite daring to.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達と、ケンカしたら、本気で、絶対、こらえ、絶対、て、絶対、お話、絶対、しようね
lines.en: Sho — if you ever fight with a friend, let's talk about it together, okay? Really talk.
lines.style: Gentle and steady, like a promise being made. Warm but serious — she means this. Slight lean-in quality. The kind of adult tone that makes a kid feel held.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達、本気で、絶対、探さ、絶対、なきゃ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I need to find a friend. I really do.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and determined beneath the small-kid voice. No drama — just stating what needs to happen. Quick tempo, purposeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、さして、絶対、忙しくないわよ
lines.en: Sho — I'm not really that busy, you know. Not right now.
lines.style: Reassuring, with a quiet underlying warmth. Like saying 'I'm here.' Slight exhale on the opening word. Patient — she's making room.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お家の壁、本気で、絶対、ペンキ、絶対、塗りたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really want to paint the wall at home. Like, really.
lines.style: Eager, bright spark in the voice. Kid-enthusiasm without being loud. A genuine wish stated simply. Small trailing energy, like imagining it.
